title: Fourier formula for randomized signs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $0\leq\delta\leq1$, and let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to[-1,1]$. The Håstad tester acceptance probability with noise parameter $\delta$ equals $\frac12+\frac12\sum_{S\subseteq[n],\,|S|\text{ odd}}(1-\delta)^{|S|}\widehat f(S)^3$, where $\widehat f(S)=\mathbb E_x[f(x)\prod_{i\in S}x_i]$ for uniform $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$.
